scope: 15-commit refactoring review (config consolidation, memory migration, utils split, dedup, hook chain)

findings.issue: Imports legacy flow-file-ops instead of canonical flow-io — parallel I/O module unmerged
findings.recommendation: Change require('./flow-file-ops') to require('./flow-io')

findings.issue: Config cache _configMtime set before substitution — transient failure poisons cache for 2s with no retry
findings.recommendation: Move _configMtime assignment after successful processing pipeline

findings.issue: Compat shim one-directional: maps execution→tasks but NOT tasks→execution
findings.recommendation: Add bidirectional mapping for all shim entries

findings.issue: Dead code in listColdStorage() — double initDatabase(), unused SQL require, unused db variable
findings.recommendation: Remove dead code, just call getEntropyStats()

findings.issue: saveDatabase() writes directly to DB_PATH without atomic temp+rename — crash corrupts SQLite
findings.recommendation: Use temp file + rename pattern

findings.issue: {file:} substitution reads any path without containment check — path traversal possible
findings.recommendation: Add path containment check matching resolveConfigValue()

findings.issue: Both use local loadConfig() with broken/missing prototype pollution protection
findings.recommendation: Replace with canonical getConfig() from flow-config-loader

findings.issue: Shebang on library module + missing 'use strict'
findings.recommendation: Remove shebang, add 'use strict'

findings.issue: Still uses process.cwd() and local raw-JSON getConfig()
findings.recommendation: Use getConfig() and PROJECT_ROOT from flow-utils

findings.issue: CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4 duplicated — should use TOKEN_ESTIMATION from flow-tokens.js
findings.recommendation: Import TOKEN_ESTIMATION.CHARS_PER_TOKEN_TEXT

findings.issue: Hook config pass-through not applied — validation still calls getConfig() directly
findings.recommendation: Add config parameter to isValidationEnabled() and getValidationCommands()

findings.issue: initPromise never reset on failure — permanently blocks retry
findings.recommendation: Reset initPromise to null in catch block

findings.issue: Config path reads hooks.rules.X but config.json nests under hooks.rules.enforcement.X — toggle has no effect
findings.recommendation: Add 'enforcement' to the config path in all 5 gate files

findings.issue: Spread-based re-exports risk silent name collision
findings.recommendation: Use explicit named exports or document the override order

findings.issue: autoPromote() marks facts as promoted in DB before writing decisions.md — crash loses rules
findings.recommendation: Write decisions.md first, then mark as promoted in DB

findings.issue: Unbounded stdin read — no MAX_STDIN_SIZE cap (unlike pre-tool-use.js)
findings.recommendation: Add 100KB MAX_STDIN_SIZE limit

findings.issue: Raw JSON.parse on DB-sourced votes/tags/files — prototype pollution via community sync
findings.recommendation: Use safeParseArray() with regex pre-check

findings.issue: 3 duplicate entries in KNOWN_CONFIG_KEYS (clarifyingQuestions, bulkOrchestrator, research)
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate the array

findings.issue: Compat shim output keys (proactiveCompaction, communitySync) missing from KNOWN_CONFIG_KEYS
findings.recommendation: Add the shimmed output key names

findings.issue: Header comment says 'thin re-export wrapper' but ~1900 lines remain
findings.recommendation: Update comment to reflect actual module contents

findings.issue: Model path constants defined locally instead of in PATHS registry
findings.recommendation: Add to PATHS in flow-paths.js

findings.issue: Dynamic require('./flow-config-defaults') inside hot-path getConfig()
findings.recommendation: Move require to module level

findings.issue: saveStats() uses direct writeFileSync instead of atomic writeJson()
findings.recommendation: Use writeJson() for consistency
